entries.reason: Preserve the procedural parse/graph/emit pipeline; fix traversal and cache.
entries.reasonZh: 保留过程式解析、依赖图、输出流程，修复遍历与缓存。

entries.reasonZh: 保留解析器与编译器分层，修复递归依赖解析。

entries.reason: Compile and precompile an escaped template from one input.
entries.reasonZh: 保留模板编译及预编译，明确输入转义边界。

entries.reason: Extract typed actions/reducers; retire duplicated CRA machinery.
entries.reasonZh: 提取类型化 actions/reducers，退役重复 CRA 底座。

entries.reason: Keep task sequencing; delegate compilation to supported TypeScript.
entries.reasonZh: 保留任务编排，用 TypeScript 原生编译器构建。

entries.reason: Keep typed class props and compare type checking with transpilation.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 class 组件类型，区分类型检查与转译。

entries.reasonZh: Hello 外壳合入 Card/Button 小型组件库与三种打包对照。

entries.reason: Retain Button; consolidate its Storybook and Webpack scaffolds.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Button，合并 Storybook 与 Webpack 底座。

entries.reason: Remove duplicate library/CRA and generated Storybook examples.
entries.reasonZh: 移除重复组件库、CRA 及自动生成的 Storybook 示例。

entries.reason: Preserve the classic architecture, add a matching modern scenario, extract handwritten mechanisms.
entries.reasonZh: 保留经典组织方式，增加同场景现代实现，提取手写机制。

entries.reason: Repair Todo editing, async import and routing on React 19 while keeping class/connect, Immutable and Saga.

entries.reason: Keep dated architecture notes; link to current implementation separately.

entries.reason: Duplicated official CRA manual is replaced by the official migration source.

entries.reasonZh: 将类型化路由概念合入现代 Todo 应用，合并生成的 Storybook 外壳。

entries.reason: Async counter and route scaffolding is represented by the fuller classic Todo/Saga scenario.
entries.reasonZh: 异步计数与路由外壳合入完整的经典 Todo/Saga 场景。

entries.reason: Keep element/component/render separation; replace shared globals with instance-local updates.
entries.reasonZh: 保留元素、组件与渲染分层，用实例局部更新替代共享全局状态。

entries.reason: Keep context, class components and History API; fix stable listeners and unmount cleanup.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Context、class 与 History API，修复监听引用与卸载清理。

entries.reason: Name the actual compose lesson; support zero functions and argument forwarding.
entries.reasonZh: 明确实际教学内容是 compose，补齐零函数与参数传递。

entries.reason: Keep Selection/Range insertion and highlight rebuilding with safe text nodes and cursor restoration.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Selection/Range 插入与高亮重建，用文本节点恢复光标。

entries.reason: Preserve representative attributed Enzyme/TestUtils cases; active behavior tests use Testing Library and browsers.
entries.reasonZh: 保存有署名的 Enzyme/TestUtils 代表用例，当前行为测试使用 Testing Library 与浏览器。
